calculation_handling.gaps: A relief side-lot-line distance for attached garages, conditional on the roof overhang distance; no licensed target for a garage distance 'to a side lot line'.

units.disclosure: On these lands an attached garage may be built as close as 0.45 metres to a side lot line if its roof overhang is no closer than 0.3 metres; we do not model this relaxed garage setback.

An addition or extension above the first storey of a lawfully existing detached house must meet the by-law's minimum building setbacks.
calculation_handling.gaps: Whether the house is lawfully existing and where an upper addition sits relative to the setbacks are not held.

units.disclosure: Any addition above the first storey of an existing detached house must meet the normal minimum setbacks (it cannot follow an existing non-complying wall line); we do not check this against the existing house.

evidence.deck_or_platform: a platform with a floor higher

calculation_handling.description: In a front or rear yard, a platform whose floor is higher than the building's first floor may not encroach into the required yard setback, despite the general platform encroachment permission.
calculation_handling.gaps: Platform floor height relative to the first floor is a design input not held.

units.disclosure: A deck or platform higher than the first floor may not project into the required front or rear yard setback on these lands; we do not model platform designs.

calculation_handling.description: Required parking spaces for a dwelling unit must be inside a building or structure.
A detached house erected before October 15, 1953 on a lot with a permitted maximum FSI of 0.6 may be enlarged by a rear addition to an overall FSI of 0.69.
calculation_handling.gaps: The lot-condition arm (a permitted maximum FSI of 0.6 and a house erected before October 15, 1953) is not modelled; the companion conditions (D)(ii)-(iv) are not modelled.

units.disclosure: Older detached houses (built before October 15, 1953) on lots with a 0.6 FSI limit may add a rear addition up to a total FSI of 0.69 if further conditions are met; we cannot confirm the house's age.

calculation_handling.description: For the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance, every finished floor level in the addition must be no higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Floor levels of the existing building are not held.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on older detached houses, the addition's floors may be no higher than the existing building's top floor; we do not check this.

calculation_handling.description: For the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance, no part of the addition may be closer to the nearest side lot line than the existing side wall of the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The existing side wall distance to the side lot line is not held.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on older detached houses, the addition may not come closer to the side lot line than the existing side wall; we do not check this.

calculation_handling.description: For the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance, any prior addition must be at least 5 years old.
calculation_handling.gaps: The age of prior additions is not held; an age in years has no DSL form.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on older detached houses, any earlier addition must be at least 5 years old; we do not hold addition dates.

900.3.10(2).explanation: Exception RD 2 sets a 330 square metre minimum lot area, makes the minimum lot frontage the frontage the lot legally had in 2013, sets 6.0 m or 3.0 m minimum rear yard setbacks for listed lots on registered plan 8673, permits front yard parking, and lets attached garages sit 0.45 m from a side lot line if the roof overhang stays 0.3 m away. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(1351).explanation: Exception RD 1351 requires upper-storey additions to existing detached houses to meet normal setbacks, bars high platforms from projecting into front or rear yard setbacks, requires parking inside a building, lets pre-1953 detached houses on 0.6 FSI lots add a rear addition up to 0.69 FSI under conditions, and bans front-wall vehicle entrances on lots 7.6 m wide or less. A section of former By-law 438-86 also prevails.
